title: Smoky Miso Potato Yakitori
description: A twist on traditional Japanese yakitori, this recipe combines smoky flavors with the sweetness of potatoes.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
Cut the potatoes into 1-inch cubes and set aside.
In a small bowl, whisk together the miso paste and chimichurri.
Add the soy sauce (if using) and whisk until combined.
Thread the potatoes onto skewers, if using.
Brush the potatoes with the miso-chimichurri mixture and season with salt and pepper.
Grill the potatoes for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until they are cooked through and slightly charred.
Serve the potatoes hot, garnished with additional chimichurri if desired.
